parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: Fear thou not; <short pause> for I am with thee: <short pause> be not dismayed; <short pause> for I am thy God: <short pause> I will strengthen thee; <short pause> yea, I will help thee; <short pause> yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness. <short pause> Isaiah, chapter forty-one, verse ten.

Father, when fear whispers tonight, remind me that You are with me. <short pause> You are my God, and Your right hand holds me steady. <short pause> Thank You for Your strength when mine runs out, for Your help when I cannot manage alone. <short pause> I belong to You. <short pause> Amen.
